entities.summary: Tai Orathai is a Thai female Luk Thung singer from Ubon Ratchatani, Thailand. She is also known as "Sao Dok Yaah". The name Sao Dok Yaah comes from her debut album. She graduated with a Bachelor's degree in the Faculty of Mass Communication from Ramkhamhaeng University.
